idea-plugin.name: Metal GPU Monitor
idea-plugin.description:
Metal GPU Monitor — Real-Time GPU Monitoring for macOS

Monitor your Apple GPU performance directly inside your JetBrains IDE. Metal GPU Monitor provides real-time utilization metrics, memory tracking, thermal state reporting, and per-process GPU usage — all without leaving your editor.

Features

  • Status Bar Widget — GPU utilization at a glance (icon + %, % only, or bar)
  • Tool Window — live chart of GPU utilization and memory, device info, and a list of GPU-related processes (the IDE and WindowServer first)
  • Thermal State — Nominal / Fair / Serious / Critical as reported by the system
  • Alerts — notifications when GPU utilization or memory exceeds your thresholds, or the thermal state becomes serious, with a cooldown
  • Data Export — the last 5 minutes of samples plus the current one as JSON or CSV

macOS does not report GPU utilization per process, so the process list shows which processes are likely using the GPU, not how much.

Requirements

  • macOS only — reads GPU statistics through the native IOKit API
  • Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
  • IntelliJ Platform 2025.1 or later
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.9.0

  • Settings refresh intervals match the tool window (50 ms - 1 s); OK no longer changes the interval silently.
  • The tool window Export button works and the export format (JSON/CSV) is configurable.
  • VRAM is read correctly; sizes and exports no longer depend on the system locale.
  • Process matching no longer hits unrelated names; thermal alerts respect the alerts setting.
  • Per-sample logging moved to DEBUG; removed unused settings.

2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/metal-gpu-monitor-plugin

1.0.0 — Initial Release

  • Real-time GPU utilization monitoring via IOKit
  • Status bar widget with configurable display format
  • Tool window with live utilization and memory charts
  • Per-process GPU usage tracking
  • Thermal state monitoring and alerts
  • Configurable alert thresholds with cooldown
  • JSON and CSV data export
  • 24-hour historical data retention
